scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The maximum applies to all tetrahedra in the real Birkhoff polytope, but the next-largest volume refers only to tetrahedra supported on four distinct permutation-matrix vertices. The n=4 exception is a reproducible exact finite enumeration, and the n>=5 proof is analytic. Historical priority is provisional; no independent audit has been carried out.
title: Sharp first tetrahedral-volume gap in Birkhoff polytopes
